content: Hello! how can I help today?
We have energy credits we can’t use this year. Can we monetize them?

Yes—**transfer** eligible clean-energy credits under **§6418**. You receive **cash** (non-taxable) from an unrelated buyer; the buyer claims the credit on their return using your **registration numbers**.

1) Complete IRS **pre-filing registration** and obtain a **registration number** for each credit property.
2) Execute a **transfer agreement** with the buyer.
3) Elect the transfer on your return and provide the registration data.
4) Buyer claims on **Form 3800/3468 series**.
Track any required **basis reduction** tied to the credit. Keep registration confirmations, the transfer contract, and placed-in-service certifications with your return.
